state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < deviceA | ('online' : false , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA 
= < deviceA | ('online' : true , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('online' : true , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('online' : true , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ....) , .....) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceA : ('owner' : UserX , ..) , ...) > < deviceA | ('online' : false , ....) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceA) 
= < cloudA | (deviceA : ('owner' : nils , ..) , ...) > < deviceA | ('online' : false , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .
